channel: execution-dev/_threads/Not really regarding weird behavior_ one
searchText: It was straightforward to create them intentionally before Spurious Dragon. But the reason 28 exist is because prior to homestead if the code deploy step of `CREATE` ran out of gas, the contract would just get created but with no code. So 28 people screwed up their contract deployment gas calculations. I support the EIP. Mostly because this keeps coming up and wasting peoples brain space. Ah right, I forgot about this code deposit check lol. Funny rules. I think we should bump the nonce and get over with it. First draft of EIP removes storage but this is more invasive and might set a weird precedent.
